title: Cancel Resume reporters when revocation release drops callbacks for a mismatched runtime
outcome: A Resume reporter carried by a deferred callback reaches one terminal or Unknown outcome when the revocation release discards that callback after its runtime token ceases to match. Reporter cancellation runs after StateInner is released.
acceptance: The runtime-token mismatch branch of release_engram_mcp_runtime_revocations_without_teardown_locked preserves reporter disposal for off-lock cancellation, including all caller returns.
A discriminating regression proves the exact Scheduled feedback row settles once without provider delivery and no longer pins transcript trimming.
